core_obligations: Choose the compactifications, perform the admissible blowups so that the closures of Z_{i,i} and Z_{i,j} are disjoint and p_1 is an isomorphism near the closure of Z_{1,2} in X'_1, and derive the emptiness of X_{12} cap (closure Z_{1,2} x_S closure Z_{2,1}) (proof lines 9798-9868).

Show that the glued schemes W_i = U coprod_{U_i} (X_i  minus closure Z_{i,j}) are separated over S by verifying with Lemma labelled lemma-check-separated that U_i -> U x_S (X_i  minus closure Z_{i,j}) is a closed immersion, using unique lifting of specializations along the proper psi_i (proof lines 9870-9890).

Prove the valuative criterion for W -> S: extend a K-point of U_1 cap U_2 into some W_i using properness of X_i over S and the emptiness result, lift along the proper W'_i -> W_i in the diagram of Lemma labelled lemma-find-common-blowups, and conclude universal closedness together with finiteness and separatedness (proof lines 9892-9947).
proof_roadmap: Set up the compactifications, the pieces Z_i and the glued W_i (proof lines 9798-9826).
Make the needed closures disjoint by admissible blowups (proof lines 9828-9832).
Build X_{12} inside X_1 x_S X_2 and arrange p_1 to be an isomorphism near the closure of Z_{1,2} (proof lines 9834-9868).
Verify separatedness of W_i -> S (proof lines 9870-9890).
Run the valuative criterion and conclude (proof lines 9892-9947).
difficulty_reason: For a Noetherian S and a scheme U of finite type and separated over S written as U = U_1 cup U_2 with U_1 and U_2 admitting compactifications over S and U_1 cap U_2 dense in U, the lemma asserts that U itself has a compactification over S (statement lines 9790-9796). The proof chooses compactifications U_i in X_i which are scheme theoretically dense, uses Lemma labelled lemma-compactification-dominates to have proper morphisms psi_i : V_i -> U extending the identifications, and sets Z_i = U  minus U_j (proof lines 9798-9808). It then blows up X_i in a V_i-admissible way so that the closures of Z_{i,i} and Z_{i,j} become disjoint (Lemma labelled lemma-separate-disjoint-locally-closed-by-blowing-up, and the disjointness condition is preserved by further admissible blowups), forms V_{12} = V_1 x_U V_2, and takes X_{12} to be the scheme theoretic image of V_{12} in X_1 x_S X_2, whose projections are proper; a further admissible blowup makes p_1 an isomorphism near the closure of Z_{1,2} by Lemma labelled lemma-blowup-iso-along, from which the emptiness of X_{12} cap (closure Z_{1,2} x_S closure Z_{2,1}) follows (proof lines 9810-9868). This is the point of the construction: it is exactly what allows the glued schemes W_i = U coprod_{U_i} (X_i  minus closure Z_{i,j}) to satisfy the valuative criterion. Separatedness of W_i -> S is checked with Lemma labelled lemma-check-separated by verifying that the immersion U_i -> U x_S (X_i  minus closure Z_{i,j}) is closed, using unique lifting of specializations along the proper psi_i (proof lines 9870-9890), and the extension property of the valuative criterion for the W_i is proved by applying properness of X_i -> S and excluding the bad case via the emptiness above (proof lines 9892-9904). The final diagram of Lemma labelled lemma-find-common-blowups is then filled by lifting along the proper W'_i -> W_i, and Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-refined-valuative-criterion-universally-closed plus finiteness and separatedness of W -> S finish the proof (proof lines 9906-9947). Building the auxiliary X_{12} with its controlled intersection and running the valuative criterion through the glued W_i is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
